items.question: Are traditional tools really free?
items.answer: Yes. Traditional and local tools stay free, including calculators, converters, and utilities.

items.question: How does trial AI credit usage work?
items.answer: Trial credits are used when you run AI tools or workflow steps that require AI processing.

items.question: Do I need a card?
items.answer: No. The beta trial uses Google sign-in and paid plans are parked for Phase 2.

items.question: Do you process my files?
items.answer: Local tools run on your device. AI tools only process content after your consent.

items.question: What happens to my data?
items.answer: We remove temporary files after processing and keep saved outputs only when you choose to save them.
